Maria (People Ops): Heads up — multiple interviewers saying scorecards are blank when they open scheduled interviews this morning. Anyone on recruiting seeing this?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Saw one from Lee earlier. Candidate timeline shows interview event but Scorecard panel is empty and "Attach template" is greyed out.
Lee (Recruiter): This hit 3 panels for EOW hiring push. I told interviewers to take notes offline but that's messy.
Nora (Hiring Ops): We have 4 hires that need feedback consolidated tonight. If scorecards aren't captured in ATS we lose structured data.
Ben (Data Eng): Can you paste a request id or example candidate id? I can check webhook and db.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): example candidate id: C-88271. Request id in logs: req_6b9f2. Posting snippet from frontend error:```
ERROR frontend: scorecard.fetch failed status=422 body={"error":"template_not_found","field":"template_id"}
```
Ben (Data Eng): 422 template_not_found — that smells like template id mismatch from the scorecard service. Was there a recent schema change?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): There was a small refactor last week: scorecard payload renamed scorecard_template_id -> template_id in the integration service. I thought we had backward compatibility.
Ben (Data Eng): Looks like compatibility layer missed one codepath (the scheduled-interview handler). I'll patch in 10m to accept both keys and log mismatches. Temp fix: I can run a backfill to attach the missing templates for affected interview ids.
Nora (Hiring Ops): Please prioritize the 4 interviews tonight. I can gather interview ids.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): List: I-2027, I-2032, I-2040, I-2041. Also, requeue webhooks for yesterday's interview events? Some webhooks returned 422 and were not retried.
nats-bot: webhook.delivery.failed \u2014 endpoint=/integrations/scorecards \u2014 code=422 \u2014 req=req_6b9f2
Ben (Data Eng): Got the list. I'll attach templates manually for those 4 and deploy compatibility patch. Backfill script will be small SQL upsert against interview_scorecards table. Example:```
UPDATE interview_scorecards SET template_id = /*resolved id*/ WHERE interview_id IN ('I-2027','I-2032','I-2040','I-2041');
```
Lee (Recruiter): Thanks Ben. Can you also add a monitoring alert for scorecard.fetch 4xx spikes so we catch this faster?
Ben (Data Eng): Yes — I'll add alerting and a dashboard row for 4xx rate by endpoint.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I requeued failed webhooks for yesterday; LMS/integrations retry queue showing them pending.
Nora (Hiring Ops): Confirmed two interviewers already submitted feedback after Ben's manual attach — forms saved. Remaining two scheduled for tonight.
Maria (People Ops): Action items: Ben patch compatibility and backfill (in progress), Sam requeue failed webhooks (done), Nora track hires and confirm final feedback captured, Lee notify interviewers of temporary workaround. Aim to close today.
Ben (Data Eng): Patch deployed and backfill ran for listed interviews. Verified interview_scorecards now have template_id populated. Monitoring alert added.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Downstream ingestion retried and most webhooks succeeded. Will follow up with a short postmortem and a test in staging for the template rename.
Maria (People Ops): Great — thanks team. I'll inform hiring managers this is resolved and ask for any remaining issues.
